cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report discloses only group-level bank balances and cash, mainly HKD/USD/RMB, without parent/subsidiary or jurisdiction split. Major operations are in mainland China, Sri Lanka and Indonesia, so upstreaming path is not proven.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash-like asset, but only partially detachable under control-buyer analysis.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Included in cash equivalents and not over three months by cash-flow presentation, but ownership and upstreaming path are not split by entity or jurisdiction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Short-term bank deposit is cash-like, but detachable value is discounted because group-level cash cannot be traced to freely distributable parent cash.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Restricted deposits were pledged as security for bills payable and bank overdraft.
Bank loans and import bills loans are interest-bearing financing liabilities and are deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financing debt must be repaid or netted before cash can be treated as detachable.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Estimated conservatively from HKD 4.44bn revenue, HKD 4.12bn cost of sales, HKD 783.9m inventories, HKD 808.1m trade/bills receivables and manufacturing working-capital volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: A going-concern textile manufacturer cannot distribute all cash without impairing working capital and production continuity.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Reserve for cross-border dividend, exchange-rate and tax friction because cash location and immediate distribution path are not disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Control buyer needs a friction reserve before treating residual cash as detachable.

profit_quality.assessment: Low confidence in reported earnings as a repeatable cash-profit base. 2023 parent profit was HKD 50.903m, but profit before tax included HKD 259.011m land resumption compensation gain. 2022 was loss-making, while operating cash flow in 2022 and 2023 was heavily helped by working-capital release during revenue decline.
adjustments: Used the 2021-2023 parent net profit median of HKD 50.903m as the pre-haircut sustainable distributable cash profit.

Applied a 0.25 profit haircut because 2023 recurring operating earnings were weak after excluding land resumption, and cash conversion depended heavily on inventory/receivable release and higher payables.
Used 2023 purchases of property, plant and equipment as a proxy for capex because maintenance capex was not separately disclosed.
Did not add back the land resumption receivable as detachable cash because it was not cash received at the balance-sheet date and is tied to a non-recurring asset event.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2023 OCF was HKD 293.758m and capex was HKD 87.871m, but operating cash before working-capital changes was only HKD 29.949m and working capital release made up most of the cash inflow.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cyclical textile manufacturing, 2022 loss, 2023 large non-recurring gain and working-capital-release-driven cash flow require a large discount to the profit denominator.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Reported OCF/parent profit for 2023 was high, but not treated as high-quality conversion because the source was mainly working-capital release and non-recurring land compensation effects.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex was not disclosed separately; 2023 PPE purchases of HKD 87.871m were used as the observable capex reference.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 cash flow benefited from inventory decrease, receivable decrease and payable increase; those releases are not assumed repeatable.

limitations: Cash and deposits are disclosed only at group level, without parent/subsidiary or jurisdiction split.
The analysis uses the rough-screen historical market cap and HKD/CNY rate from 2024-05-27, not a current market cap.
The profit denominator is heavily discounted because 2023 reported profit included a large land resumption gain and 2022 was loss-making.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed.
This is a control-buyer cash and earnback analysis, not investment advice, a target price or a buy/sell recommendation.
